hero.titleLine1: Reliable procurement for the world's most
hero.subtitle: PilotGov connects government departments with vetted startups to discover, pilot, and scale innovative public-sector solutions — without the friction of traditional tendering.

problem.title: Public procurement wasn't built for startups
problem.subtitle: Legacy tender processes favor large incumbents, demand multi-year track records, and take so long that most innovative firms never apply. The public sector loses, and citizens lose with it.
problem.stat1Label: of public tenders are won by startups today
problem.stat2Label: average time from tender to contract signature
problem.stat3Label: of procurement rules create barriers for small firms

howItWorks.title: From challenge to scaled contract in four steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Departments post a challenge; eligible startups are matched automatically by domain and capability.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Run a time-boxed, funded pilot with clear success metrics — no multi-year commitment required.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Outcomes are measured against predefined KPIs and published on a transparent public dashboard.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Verified pilots convert to scaled procurement contracts through a fast-track framework.

postNeed.title: Post a need, not a tender
postNeed.subtitle: Describe the outcome your department needs. Eligible startups are matched by domain and capability — no RFP required to get started.
postNeed.placeholderDescription: What outcome do you need, and what does success look like?

discovery.title: Find the right startup for every public challenge
discovery.subtitle: Search across DPIIT-recognized startups by domain, capability, and eligibility status. Every match comes with a transparent score so departments can evaluate fit at a glance.
discovery.bullet3: Public track record of past pilots

pilot.title: Track every pilot from application to scale
pilot.subtitle: A transparent board for departments and startups to follow pilot progress, budgets, and milestones in real time.

trust.title: Every pilot outcome, published publicly
trust.subtitle: Citizens deserve to see what works. PilotGov publishes pilot results, budgets, and KPI outcomes on an open dashboard — building accountability into every stage of public innovation.
